title: DEBUG defaults to True: Swagger UI (/docs) exposed in production by default
description: config.py:10 sets DEBUG from env with default 'True' (`os.getenv('DEBUG', 'True').lower() == 'true'`), and main.py:10 exposes docs_url='/docs' whenever DEBUG is true. No .env or deployment descriptor exists in the repo, so a default deployment serves the interactive OpenAPI/Swagger UI to the internet, advertising the full API schema, parameter models and validation rules - a free recon/intel asset for attackers. Additionally, /health (main.py:32-34) discloses app name/version.
impact: Unauthenticated disclosure of the complete API surface and schema (OpenAPI), easing targeted attacks; minor version disclosure via /health.
mitigation: Default DEBUG to False (fail-safe), require an explicit env var to enable; gate /docs behind DEBUG in production; consider hiding /health internals.
